title: Target Reimagines Home Brand Threshold with More Style, Design and Value
summary: More than 800 new items bring a broader range of styles, elevated quality and accessible value to guests Refreshed shopping experience makes Threshold easier to discover and shop The reinvention...
body_markdown:
- *More than 800 new items bring a broader range of styles, elevated quality and accessible value to guests*
- *Refreshed shopping experience makes Threshold easier to discover and shop*
- *The reinvention marks a significant step in Target's multi-year effort to reinforce its style authority in Home*


MINNEAPOLIS


, Oct. 27, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- **Target Corporation (NYSE: TGT)** today announced significant updates to Threshold, its largest owned Home brand, giving guests more ways to discover stylish, well-designed products at accessible prices to create homes that reflect their personal style. The reinvention includes more than 800 new items and more inspiring, intuitive shopping experiences in all stores and online.


The reinvention of Threshold, a nearly $3 billion owned brand, is part of Target's multi-year strategy to reinforce its style authority in Home with more distinctive products and shopping experiences that reflect how guests live and decorate today.


"Homes are an extension of our guests' personalities and sense of style, and Target's Threshold reinvention makes it easier for everyone to create spaces they'll love," said Mara Sirhal, senior vice president, merchandising, home, Target. "As we've refreshed Threshold throughout the year and continue to rebuild our Home business, it's exciting to see how guests are already responding to the merchandising authority we bring with a range of styles, elevated design, and incredible value."


**A fresh perspective on style, design and everyday value**


Threshold's reinvention brings together improvements across products and the shopping experience, with thoughtful updates that make it easier for guests to create spaces that feel like their own.


Key updates include:


- **A fresh take on essentials** : Design-forward essentials feature improved quality, materials and thoughtful details, including refreshed barware and serveware, bedding in fabrics like gauze and textured cotton, and decorative accessories with elevated finishes.
- **More ways to express personal style:** Target's research shows guests mix three or more design aesthetics in their homes. Threshold's expanded range, from traditional to contemporary, offers more choices across decorative accessories, bedding, tabletop and other Home essentials.
- **Everyday value on essentials:** Style, design and value are at the center of this brand refresh and reflect Target's[recently lowered prices](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4806846-1&h=729502234&u=https%3A%2F%2Fcorporate.target.com%2Fpress%2Frelease%2F2026%2F09%2Ftarget-lowers-prices-on-nearly-2%2C000-products%2C-offering-even-more-style-and-design-at-an-incredible&a=recently+lowered+prices) on guest-favorite Threshold bedding items, including Performance Sheets, now $50 for queen and $60 for king, while introducing refreshed colors and prints. Select Threshold queen comforters are also now $69, down from $89.
- **An inspiring, easy-to-shop experience:** Key Home categories, like decorative pillows, throws and tabletop decor, are now merchandised together, making it easier for guests to discover complementary colors, patterns and textures for every room. Select stores also feature elevated wood fixtures to enhance the experience.


**Shaping what's next for Target Home**


Reinvented products already in market, including throws, decorative accessories and candles, are seeing double-digit growth. Tests of updated product presentations in stores show mid-single-digit lifts in sales and units.


Building on this momentum, Target will continue to evolve Threshold with fresh styles, elevated design and exceptional value, reinforcing its position as a go-to destination for Home.


**About Target**


Target Corporation (NYSE: TGT) brings together style, design and value to offer a distinct assortment and elevated shopping experience across more than 2,000 U.S. stores and online. Powered by more than 400,000 team members, Target serves millions of families each week and invests in the communities where they live and work to support growth and opportunity for all.
